name: 40143-manyimage-e4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- engine defaults; the item is single-GPU.
architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration -- a Gemma-4 E4B multimodal instruct checkpoint, served here with the vision path only; needs transformers >= 5.5.0.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, no warmup, no cooldown, bounded at 128 requests -- one request per stream, so the run is a single wave. safety_seconds=1800 is a timeout, not a workload parameter.
workload: single-turn many-image vision prompts: 128 JPEG images of 128x192 plus ~58 tokens of text per request, then exactly 8000 generated tokens; 128 requests at concurrency 128. ~8003 input tokens per request, the engine running with `max_soft_tokens: 70` so each image occupies a 62-token placeholder; output length is exact (max_tokens with ignore_eos); images are row-index seeded so all 16384 in the run are distinct; driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A visual archive assistant writing long reports from 128-image batches, 128 concurrent single-turn requests on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: engine defaults plus the declared choices for this workload.

model: google/gemma-4-E4B-it

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE: the engine's config reader takes this file line by line and skips
# indented ones, so a block mapping here drops the key silently and the engine starts at rc=0
# with the modality limit at its default.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 128}

# ALSO ONE LINE, same reader. 70 is one of the five values this checkpoint's processor accepts
# (70, 140, 280, 560, 1120); anything else raises ValueError inside the processor and every
# request errors while the run still exits 0. At 70 each image occupies a 62-token placeholder
# (60 embeds) and reaches the vision tower as 630 patches, against 262 / 260 / 2520 at the
# default. 128 images therefore carry exactly the same 80,640 patches, and nearly the same
# prompt length, as 32 images at the default -- 8003 tokens against 8451.
mm-processor-kwargs: {"max_soft_tokens": 70}

max-num-seqs: 128
max-model-len: 32768
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# REQUIRED, or every request errors and the run still exits 0. This checkpoint's HF processor
# validates the image-token count in the text against the images handed to it; the engine's
# cached input path tokenizes the prompt on its own and raises "Found 128 <|image|> tokens in
# the text but no images were passed." Zero also costs this workload nothing: all 16384 images
# are row-index seeded and distinct, so the cache can never return a hit.
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0

# KV stays at the engine default (bf16), and it fits. Layers 24-41 share KV
# (num_kv_shared_layers=18), so only layers 0-23 allocate: 20 sliding ones capped at a 512-token
# window (21.0 MB/seq, flat in context) and 4 full-attention ones carrying global_head_dim=512
# with 2 KV heads, i.e. 4 x 2 x 2 x 512 x 2 B = 16 kB per token per sequence. At 128 sequences
# running out to 16,003 tokens that is 33.6 GB of KV beside ~16 GB of weights, inside the 0.9
# utilization budget. fp8 was measured on this item and cost ~3.5% of output throughput instead
# of saving any, so it is not applied.
# The heterogeneous head dims (256 sliding / 512 global) force TRITON_ATTN for this model:
# FlashAttention rejects head sizes above 256.
